briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief — Wed 2026-10-07 (SGT)

  • NAV S$10,300,066 (−0.28% reported; ≈ +0.02% real vs restated base). Listed sleeve −1.52%. Restatement night 9: Oct 6 revised to S$10,298,319 (−S$332).
  • Biggest mover: SPX 7,818.93 +0.58% and Nasdaq 27,599.79 +0.45% — both records; in-book, Tencent +1.23% reclaimed the 425 line.
  • One thing: duration-led record session (30y eased off 24-yr high, VIX 15.01, utilities led on Constellation-Google nuclear PPA) while HK set up a +1.00% short-cover rally into Thursday’s mainland return.

Flags — day 7, both stale-verified

  • Xiaomi −6.2% flag FALSE: stale Sep 28 baseline 25.86 (24.26/25.86 = −6.19% exact match); actual Tuesday +1.59% to HK$24.26.
  • CDL −5.9% flag FALSE: stale Sep 29 baseline 7.43 (6.99/7.43 = −5.92% exact match); actual −0.43% to S$6.99 — but closed sub-7.00 on a 7th straight down day.

Overnight

  • US: 10y 5.27%, 30y ≈5.64–5.65%; RUT −0.59% red on record day. CEG +12% (20-yr Google PPA). Memory dumped: STX −9%, WDC −7%, SK Hynix −6.5%.
  • HK: HSI 24,280.56 +1.00%, turnover HK$98.3bn. Tencent 428.20 +1.23%, Xiaomi 24.26 +1.59%, SMIC 61.55 +0.41%. Mainland returns Thursday.
  • SGX: STI 5,701.54 +0.66%; DBS 78.56 +0.94%; CDL 6.99 −0.43%.
  • Metals (mid-session): gold ≈$4,170, silver ≈$61.4 +~0.9% (under $62). GDX 88.22 +0.92%, SILJ 27.34 +0.85%, SLVP 35.10 +0.46%.

Insider / Congress

  • Wing Tai: two new Oct 6 filings — Change in Interests of Director + Grant of Share Awards (insider accumulation continues). IR page
  • Congress (filed Oct 5): House OH-6: Buy GS, Sell MSFT + WFC ($1–15K each); House CA-11: Buy REOF XXX LLC $500K–$1M. Unusual Whales

Policy watch

  • Fed hawkish: Daly flags an “AI-fueled chip squeeze”; Dec hike ~69–87% priced; FOMC minutes today. Newsquawk
  • AI/grid: Constellation-Google 20-yr nuclear PPA; DoE $4.2bn nuclear; DeepSeek weighs doubled $15bn round.
  • Iran/Hormuz: Trump says war over “soon”; Qatar mediation; tanker DRAGON FORTUNE turned back despite US escort.
  • Trade: Rubio — FTA era unlikely to return; US-China discuss reciprocal nuclear site visits (CNN).

Risk

  • CDL sub-7.00, 7th down day — SG property cluster is the book’s most rate-sensitive sleeve; Wing Tai insiders buying into weakness.
  • FX ~35% non-SGD; USDSGD 1.2776 (firmer SGD).
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz ≈ S$139.4k vs S$56.24k loan → equity ≈ S$83.2k, ~1.68x; −4% silver day ≈ −6.7% equity.
  • Memory crash = tell for Xiaomi BOM cost relief; watch rotation vs down-cycle.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Tencent 0700: 425 reclaimed pre-mainland-return; Thursday southbound volume confirms or kills.
  • AI-power/grid: bid broadening from chips to power (CEG PPA, DoE $4.2bn, DeepSeek $15bn) — grid sleeve is the deployment candidate.
  • Defense sleeve: 30y 5.65% vs sub-5.15% trigger still far; FOMC minutes today — hold fire.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawkish lean into December; FOMC minutes today
trumpWatch.detail: Daly (2027 voter) very pleased with the Sep hike; told Axios companies are preparing for an "AI-fueled chip squeeze" that could push prices far beyond the data-centre boom — AI, tariffs and energy shocks could compound into more tightening. Schmid: credibility at stake. December hike ~69–87% priced.

trumpWatch.title: AI/grid bottleneck broadens: Constellation–Google 20-yr nuclear PPA
trumpWatch.detail: CEG +12% on the PPA; Monday DoE $4.2bn nuclear package (PA/OH); DeepSeek considering doubling its funding round to $15bn (CNBC). The AI bid is moving from chips to the power behind them.

trumpWatch.title: Iran/Hormuz: Trump says war over "soon"; tanker turned back despite escort
trumpWatch.detail: Millions of barrels moved through Hormuz in recent days; Qatar mediation ongoing, Doha talks constructive; Iran defiant. Emirati tanker DRAGON FORTUNE turned back from Hormuz despite US escort; missiles launched toward Hormuz; Houthis claim they can close Saudi airports/ports; coalition intercepted a ballistic missile toward Khamis Mushait.

trumpWatch.title: Trade: Rubio — FTA era unlikely to return; quiet US–China nuclear channel
trumpWatch.detail: Rubio said the era of free-trade agreements is unlikely to return for the foreseeable future. US and China in informal preliminary discussions on reciprocal nuclear site visits (CNN). China MOFCOM warned France/Germany on protectionism; monitoring UK EV tariffs.

trumpWatch.title: Russia: EU to approve ~1,570-entity sanctions; Putin–Xi APEC bilateral confirmed
trumpWatch.detail: EU envoys to approve a major new sanctions package Wednesday (~1,570 entities, missile production). Zelensky warns Russia is preparing a "massive attack". Kremlin confirmed a Putin–Xi bilateral at November APEC; called a trilateral with Trump an "interesting idea". Bulgarian Black Sea drone strike hit 2 ships.

trumpWatch.title: Trump on the dollar: "very strong… but you can make the case it slows things down"
trumpWatch.detail: Trump talked up dollar strength while nodding to its drag; midterm rally comments. BoE Mann warned supply shocks are embedding inflation — global hawkish backdrop intact.

opportunities.thesis: HK barbell: reclaimed the 425 line (close 428.20, day low 425.60) the day before the mainland returns; HSI +1.00% on HK$98.3bn with platform/biotech leadership. Monday’s provisional break voided.
opportunities.signal: A Thursday hold above 425 with southbound inflow is the add trigger; a close back below 425 on mainland selling voids it.

opportunities.thesis: The bottleneck bid is broadening from chips to power: Constellation–Google 20-yr nuclear PPA (CEG +12%), DoE $4.2bn nuclear, Daly’s "chip squeeze" framing, DeepSeek weighing a $15bn round. Memory dump (STX −9%) looks like rotation, not demand destruction.
opportunities.signal: Grid/uranium names catching the incremental bid — the barbell’s grid sleeve is the deployment candidate while chip leadership gets crowded.

opportunities.thesis: Bonds rallied Tuesday (30y eased from 5.684% to ~5.65%, solid JGB auction, French OAT relief) but the rally-and-hold trigger sub-5.15% remains distant; capitulation arm paused.
opportunities.signal: No deployment this week — FOMC minutes today could re-steepen; keep powder earmarked and let the minutes print first.
